versions.subject: Windows redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_cmd:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all: 
        - vaultcmd
        - '/listcreds:'
selection_option:
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'Windows Credentials'
        - 'Web Credentials'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*vaultcmd*" ScriptBlockText="*/listcreds:*" ScriptBlockText IN ("*Windows Credentials*", "*Web Credentials*")
